title: Network Bulletin: Cash Pickup Reactivation Fee After Out-of-Cash Refusals
content:
When a Cash Pickup payout location has refused a pickup on a transfer because it had no cash, the network bears part or all of the tier's reactivation fee on that transfer.

**Rule.** Count the pickups refused on the transfer because the payout location had no cash. The count sets the share of the tier's reactivation fee that remains to be charged.

| Out-of-cash refusals recorded on the transfer | Share of the tier's reactivation fee charged |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0 percent: the tier fee is waived entirely |
| exactly one | 60 percent |
| none | 100 percent: the whole tier fee |

Refusals for any other reason do not count. Those reasons are a name on the ID that does not match, an expired ID, no valid ID shown, and a wrong Pickup Number.

**What the share acts on.** The share applies to the tier's listed reactivation fee alone. The network-shared fee is the tier's reactivation fee multiplied by the share, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical)

| Tier's listed fee | Out-of-cash refusals | Network-shared fee |
|---|---|---|
| 4.99 | 1 | 60 percent of 4.99 is 2.994, rounded to 2.99 |
| 9.99 | 1 | 5.994, rounded to 5.99 |
| 4.99 | 2 | 0.00 |
| 4.99 | 0 | 4.99 |
